# Caret

> Caret is a free, open-source online typing test and typing practice application.

Official website: https://caret.voltcrash.com/
Source repository: https://github.com/voltcrash/caret
License: GPL-3.0

Caret measures typing speed in words per minute (WPM) and accuracy. It runs in a
modern web browser with JavaScript enabled. Tests can be taken without an account;
signing in enables saved results and account history.

Practice modes include time, words, quotes, zen and custom text. Users can choose
language and code word lists, punctuation, numbers, themes, fonts and caret settings.
Code lists support transcription practice, not programming instruction or assessment.
Caret began from the Monkeytype codebase and is now an independent project.

## Public pages

- [Typing test](https://caret.voltcrash.com/): Start a free typing test.
- [About Caret](https://caret.voltcrash.com/about): Product overview, practice guides and common questions.
- [Typing guides](https://caret.voltcrash.com/guide): Browse all typing practice guides.
- [Typing practice](https://caret.voltcrash.com/guide/typing-practice): A practice routine, accuracy, modes and consistent comparisons.
- [Typing speed test](https://caret.voltcrash.com/guide/typing-speed-test): Taking a test and understanding WPM, raw speed and accuracy.
- [Typing for programmers](https://caret.voltcrash.com/guide/typing-for-programmers): Code word lists, custom text and practice limits.
- [Leaderboards](https://caret.voltcrash.com/leaderboards): Public typing and XP rankings.
- [Privacy policy](https://caret.voltcrash.com/privacy-policy.html): Data handling and privacy information.
